newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria to raise power prices by 19 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Algeria to raise power prices by 19 pct in 1997.

text.p: Algeria's state-owned electricity utility will increase prices by 19 percent in 1997, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Saturday.
The hike is aimed at recouping costs of "heavy investments" made by the utility, Societe Nationale d'Electricite et de Gaz (Sonelgaz), APS said.
Sonelgaz said the electricity prices were low in Algeria, at 1.5 dinars ($0.026 cents) per kilowatt-hour compared with 11 dinars ($0.19) in neighbouring countries.
The increase will be graduated over 1997, starting off with a 4.5 percent hike in the first quarter of the year. ($1 = 56 dinars)
